title: Club Desire acts, dancers and comedians
summary: Dance shows and acts; Peg Leg Bates, Butterbeans and Susie and Pigmeat at the Palace Theatre.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What about, let's see, we got to Club Desire, did they have any acts there? Club Desire?
Yeah, Club Desire had some acts like, like the Doudrop, you know, some of them people wearing dresses and things.
Did they have dancers ever?
Yeah, they had dancers, they had beautiful dance flow.
I mean on stage, did they ever have anybody who did a tap dance?
Yeah, they had dance shows.
Who would be in those shows?
Well, the same people like, when they wasn't at the Doudrop, they was there.
I just wondered if they had any big name dancers.
Yeah, you don't know, yeah.
Did you ever see Peg Leg Bates? Oh yeah, man, something. Did you ever work with him?
No, I never worked with him.
What about Butter Beans and Suze here? I don't know. Big Meat, Markham, any of those people?
I never worked with those people.
They never didn't have that stuff at the, did they come to town?
Butter Beans and Suze, sure they came to, when they had the Palace Theatre, Dorthy and what that was there was, the Piavels, Butter Beans and Suze, the Palace Theatre.
The Pig Meat was there.
The Pig Meat, all those people come back. I was a kid, I was not a kid, I remember that.
Yeah. Yeah, because I wondered what kind of comedians I had in these places.
Good, good old childhood man.
